# ENV010: Git identity or project line-ending policy needs attention

<!-- Code generated by cmd/rulegen from the builtin registry. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Component: git. Severity: warning.

Collector prerequisites: git, deps.

Effective Git identity is incomplete or core.autocrlf disagrees with the project's explicit policy.

Evidence required: Completed effective Git identity inspection, or a config-origin-backed conflict with explicit gitAutocrlf project policy.

Manual steps:

- Set the intended Git identity or align core.autocrlf with the project's documented policy after reviewing the reported config origins.

Verify with `envdoctor diagnose --rule ENV010`.

Limitations:

- Git user.name/user.email remain visible in JSON by the M2 sharing contract; origin home paths are redacted.
- An absent core.autocrlf defaults to false. OS choice alone does not prove a conflict.
- eol attributes override autocrlf and do not by themselves prove a conflict. Policy is explicit gitAutocrlf in the requirements file.
- Invalid/denied config and unchecked older snapshots remain inconclusive. No Git configuration is changed.

No command is executed by this rule. Evidence comes only from the snapshot. Failed prerequisite collectors disable the rule. Positive, negative and edge fixtures cover Windows, Linux and macOS; platform exclusions are listed above.

Documentation: <https://github.com/shellghostt/envdoctor/blob/main/docs/rules/ENV010.md>.
